fixed_evidence.text: Draft schedule v1, created Monday: project review, Thursday at 09:30 local time.
Signed amendment v2, created Tuesday by the organizer: project review moved to Thursday at 10:00 local time. This amendment replaces the time in v1.

question: What meeting time is supported by these records? Distinguish the original schedule from the current instruction and explain the basis.

semantic_content.answer: Within these records, the current meeting time is Thursday at 10:00 local time. The original v1 draft scheduled Thursday at 09:30 local time; the later signed v2 amendment moves it to 10:00 and expressly says it replaces v1’s time. This conclusion is limited to the supplied records.
